title: Buy YouTube Views: packages for your next video
summary: A guide to Regular, Fast and Ads Views, package sizes, and what to check before placing an order.
sections: Start with your video and your goal

Before choosing a package, decide which video you want to promote and what you want to learn from the campaign. A single video link gives the order a clear destination. Keep a note of its current view count so you have a useful starting point when checking delivery.

YoutubeADwords lists three YouTube Views tiers: Regular Views, Fast Views and Ads Views. They have different package sizes and prices. Compare the tier as well as the headline quantity; two packages with similar names are not necessarily the same offer.
Compare the available packages

The imported Regular Views catalogue starts at 100 views for $1.34 and includes 1,000, 2,500 and 5,000 views. Fast Views offers larger quantities, starting at 10,000 views. Ads Views starts at 500,000 views in the captured catalogue.

These are USD prices captured from the service site, not a live quotation. Open the service page to review the complete package list, then confirm the price and available options in the existing checkout before purchasing.
Share the right public link
Use the public link to the video you intend to promote. Check that it opens the correct video before continuing. The ordering process asks for a link, not your social media password.
If you are unsure which tier fits your needs, ask support before ordering. Include the video link and the package you are considering so the team can answer a specific question.
Follow delivery in My Orders
Track the order from your account. Delivery timing depends on the service and package, so treat general delivery descriptions as estimates rather than a promise for every order.

Keep your order number handy when contacting support. For missing delivery or a drop after completion, review the refill and refund terms for the selected service. A package purchase is not a guarantee of sales, channel performance or a particular business result.

title: Grow your reach with Google Ads campaigns
summary: Understand Skip Ads, Display Ads, app installs and website traffic before choosing your campaign.
sections: Choose the service that matches your destination

YoutubeADwords offers four Google Ads service lines: Google Skip Ads Views, Google Display Ads Views, Google Apps Download, and Google Ads Website / App Traffic. Start with what you want people to reach: a video, an app or a website.

These services describe different types of delivery. A video-view package, an app-install package and a website-traffic package should not be compared on quantity alone. Check the unit being purchased before comparing prices.
Video and display packages
The captured Skip Ads catalogue starts at 50,000 views for $100. The Display Ads catalogue starts at 50,000 views for $80. Both include larger quantities and a custom option.
Display Ads also lists content-targeted, worldwide and country-targeted options. Review the complete tier details and ask the team which targeting options are available for your campaign.
Apps and website traffic
Google Apps Download packages list installs as the delivery unit. The captured worldwide catalogue starts at 5,000 installs for $300, with a separate Tier-1 country option.
Website / App Traffic packages start at 50,000 in the captured catalogue. Confirm the destination link and the kind of traffic you need before submitting an order.
Plan the campaign before you pay

Prepare the public destination URL, intended audience and package size. For a custom campaign, contact support for the scope and price instead of assuming a listed package includes every targeting requirement.

The local catalogue is a snapshot. Final availability and pricing belong to the existing checkout. Keep the order reference and use My Orders to follow delivery; contact support if the recorded order does not match what you selected.

title: Choose a service, share a link, track your order
summary: A practical walkthrough of package selection, public links, order tracking and support.
sections: 1. Choose your service and package

Open the YouTube or Google Ads service that matches your goal. Review the delivery unit, package quantity, price and available tier. Views, subscribers, likes, watch hours, installs and website traffic are separate services.
The service cards on this frontend take you to the existing YoutubeADwords purchasing flow. Confirm the current package details there before completing checkout.
2. Check your public link

Copy the link to the intended video, channel, app or website. Open it yourself to confirm that it points to the right destination. A wrong URL can make an order difficult to resolve, and the source refund policy specifically addresses incorrect order information.
You do not need to hand over a social media password. If you need help identifying the correct link, contact support before proceeding.
3. Keep your order reference
After purchasing, use your account’s My Orders page to follow the order. Keep the order number, package name and destination link together so you can refer to them later.
Delivery times vary by service and package. Check the order information and contact support when you need an update rather than assuming every package follows the same schedule.
4. Ask for help with the details attached
For an order question, send the order number and a clear description of the issue. The contact page offers categories for general inquiries, order questions, technical support and refund requests.

Read the Refund Policy before buying. The source policy describes eligibility, refill attempts, duplicate orders and review times. A request is reviewed against those terms; submitting a request does not itself mean a refund has been approved.

title: Grow your audience with YouTube subscribers
summary: Compare the subscriber tiers and prepare your channel link before choosing a package.
sections: Understand the three tiers

The subscriber service lists Regular Subs., Natural Growth and Influencer+ packages. Each tier has its own quantities and pricing. Start by reviewing the full tier rather than picking only the largest displayed number.

The captured Regular Subs. options range from 100 to 10,000 subscribers. The first package is listed at $5.03 for 100 subscribers, with additional options for 250, 500, 1,000, 2,500, 5,000 and 10,000.
Use your channel link

Subscriber orders are for a channel. Check the destination carefully and keep a copy with your order details. The service describes a public-link workflow, so your social media password should stay with you.
If your channel name has changed or you manage several channels, verify the URL before checkout. A familiar display name is not a substitute for confirming the actual destination.
Separate delivery from wider goals

A subscriber package specifies a quantity and service type. It does not by itself establish how your content will perform, what viewers will watch next or whether a particular business goal will be reached.
Use the package information to decide what you are ordering. For questions about delivery methods, targeting or refill eligibility, ask support for the terms that apply to your selected tier.
Review the current offer
The prices shown in this frontend were imported from the source catalogue. Check the final price in checkout and read the refund policy before paying.
After ordering, follow progress in My Orders. If something needs attention, send the order number and channel link to support so the team can identify the correct purchase.

title: Explore YouTube likes packages
summary: What to review when choosing a likes package and how to follow your order after purchase.
sections: Know what the package includes
The YouTube Likes page lists Slow Likes and Turbo Likes options. A likes order is distinct from a views or subscribers order: check the service name and quantity before proceeding.
The captured entry package is 20 likes for $0.53. Other standard quantities include 100, 250, 500 and 1,000 likes. Larger options appear in the complete tier catalogue.
Choose the intended video
Copy the public URL of the video you want to use, then open it to check that it is correct. If you are promoting several videos, clarify how the order should be arranged before purchasing.
Keep the destination URL and selected package with your order number. These details make support questions much easier to resolve than a screenshot of a changing count on its own.
Check the delivery and refill terms
Service descriptions include delivery and refill information, but conditions can differ by package. Ask support if a specific timeframe or refill period is important to your decision.
Read the Refund Policy before placing the order. For eligible drops, the source policy describes attempting a refill before considering a refund where a refill cannot resolve the issue.
Follow up from your account
Track progress in My Orders and contact support with the reference when necessary. Confirm current prices in the purchasing flow: the local catalogue is not a live feed.
Treat the order as the specified service, not a promise of wider outcomes. A likes quantity is not a guarantee of future views, subscribers, sales or a particular audience response.

title: Build your viewing time with YouTube Watch Hours
summary: Review watch-hour quantities, pricing and delivery questions before choosing a package.
sections: Read the unit carefully
The Watch Hours service lists viewing time in hours. It is a different purchase from a view-count package, so compare packages using the stated unit rather than the largest number on a card.
The imported catalogue includes 1,000, 1,500, 2,000, 3,000 and 4,000 hours. The entry package is listed at $80.55 for 1,000 hours. Confirm current availability and pricing in checkout.
Prepare your video link and questions
Check the public link for the video you intend to use. If you have questions about the video’s suitability or the expected delivery schedule, contact support before ordering.
The service page contains the captured package details and FAQs. Read those alongside the refund policy rather than assuming a general description applies identically to every order.
Keep your expectations specific

Order delivery and a platform’s eligibility decisions are separate matters. Do not treat a package description as confirmation that a channel has qualified for monetization or any other platform programme.

Ask for clarification about what the order delivers and how it will appear in your account. When assessing your channel, use the information available in your platform dashboard instead of relying only on a promotional claim.
Track the purchase and keep a record
Use My Orders for the order status, and retain the package name, quantity and public link. Delivery estimates depend on the selected service and order size.

For a delivery issue, contact support with the order number. Refund and refill requests are governed by the published terms and are reviewed individually; no approval is implied by submitting a request.

title: Get app installs with Google Ads
summary: Compare worldwide and Tier-1 install options and prepare your app campaign details.
sections: Start with the app and audience
Google Apps Download is the app-install service in the YoutubeADwords catalogue. It lists Worldwide installs and Tier-1 Country Installs, with examples including the USA, UK and Canada.
Before choosing a tier, identify the app link and the audience you intend to reach. Ask support to confirm any geographic requirement that matters to your campaign.
Compare the published quantities
The captured Worldwide catalogue starts at 5,000 installs for $300. It also lists 10,000, 50,000 and 100,000 installs, plus a custom quantity option. Tier-1 packages have a separate price list.
Review the full catalogue rather than assuming the same quantity has the same price across targeting options. The final quotation and availability should be confirmed in the existing checkout.
Clarify the scope of a custom order
For a custom request, prepare your app destination, intended country coverage and desired quantity. Contact support for the price and scope before making payment.
Keep a written record of the selected service. App installs, app ratings and reviews are different items; do not assume a package includes additional services unless the offer explicitly says so.
Follow delivery and ask precise questions
Track the order from your account and keep its reference available. For a support request, include the app link, package and the issue you are seeing.

A delivered install quantity is not a promise of ongoing app usage, purchases or another business outcome. Review the service terms and refund policy before ordering, and evaluate your wider campaign separately from the order’s stated delivery unit.
